answer: Entry should work like docking at a busy wharf: each epoch auctions limited entry slots, and every newcomer submits a sealed bid. Winners pay the clearing price as a non-refundable deposit, so buying 1,000 fake slots costs about $40,000 against a $3,000 epoch pool, while one honest agent pays $40 once and keeps its full share. Bids ripple out as a public price signal, and cheaters hit the reef: their deposit is slashed and the slot re-auctioned.
